text:
Sophie: Customer onboards today — they entered promo code NEWUSER2025 at signup but it landed on a Dedicated SKU (dedicated-small) instead of the Hosted SKU they selected (hosted-pro). Account acct_9876, tenant td-3345. Can billing / ops reassign and issue any necessary credit?

Billing Bot: Found applied promo on invoice. Quick trace: 
```
promo_code: NEWUSER2025
applied_to_sku: dedicated-small
invoice_id: INV-2025-0112
tenant: td-3345
signup_timestamp: 1798232910
```

Marcus: Thanks — can you paste the signup flow link or order id? Need to reproduce the selection vs what backend saw. Also what's the expected credit amount if we move it to hosted?

Sophie: order-55512, signup page was the normal self-serve hosted flow (customer explicitly chose Hosted -> hosted-pro). Customer says Dedicated was never selected. Expected difference: promo covers $200 and hosted usage would apply fully; dedicated has reserved pricing so we need to credit the dedicated allocation and reapply to hosted usage (~$150 delta).

Carlos: I pulled the allocation logs for tenant td-3345. There's a mapping fallback we introduced for legacy signups: if "deployment_preference" missing, fallback SKU = dedicated-small. In this case the signup payload missed 'deployment_preference' due to a client-side race, so backend defaulted to dedicated. Looks like a client JS race on the toggle.

Marcus: Ok that explains it. Remediation plan: 1) Reassign promo code from dedicated-small -> hosted-pro for tenant td-3345, 2) Apply a $150 credit to acct_9876 invoice INV-2025-0112, 3) Patch signup fallback to prefer hosted for self-serve signups, 4) Notify customer and confirm. I can run the billing ops commands if finance approves.

Iris: Approving the $150 credit and reassign. Marcus, go ahead and proceed. Also add a note to the ticket explaining client-side cause; we should offer a courtesy extra $25 for the friction.

Marcus: On it. Running the reassign now. Commands used: 
```
# reassign promo
POST /billing/promos/reassign 
{ "promo_code": "NEWUSER2025", "from_sku": "dedicated-small", "to_sku": "hosted-pro", "tenant": "td-3345" }

# create credit
POST /billing/credits 
{ "account_id": "acct_9876", "amount": 15000, "currency": "USD", "reason": "promo misapplied - reassign to hosted" }
```

Billing Bot: Reassign job queued: job_id jb-7821. Credit created: CR-2025-998. Invoice INV-2025-0112 updated with credit line.

Marcus: Done — promo reassign completed and credit applied. I also added a manual note to the promo history: "reassigned from dedicated-small to hosted-pro for tenant td-3345; courtesy $25 applied".

Sophie: Thanks all — I'll message the customer: "Hi — we corrected the promo application and applied a $150 credit plus a $25 courtesy credit; you should see it on invoice INV-2025-0112. Sorry for the trouble — we also pushed a fix to avoid this fallback." :bow:

Carlos: I pushed a small guard in the signup service to default to the user-selected option when present and include stricter logging for missing deployment_preference. Prod deploy in 10m.

Iris: Great. Please add a short retro note in the postmortems channel about the fallback logic; flagged for devex to update the signup SDK docs so embed flows always set deployment_preference.

Sophie: Customer confirmed receipt, says invoice shows credit and they accepted the courtesy. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
